propositions: REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE environment variable must name a TOML file whose keys layer over discovered config on a per-key basis rather than replacing it wholesale.
Configuration precedence must be: CLI -c llm.KEY > REBAR_LLM_<KEY> env > REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE > discovered config file > default.
Nested tables in the pointed file must deep-merge with discovered config (leaf key wins), while arrays must replace wholesale and never append.
The env var must be read as a string literal in os.environ.get("REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE") so that the static AST scanner in gen_env_registry.py documents it correctly in docs/env-vars.md.
A pointer to a missing file must raise a typed rebar config error naming the variable rather than silently falling back.
The deep merge logic must be isolated to the LLM resolver and must not alter read_reserved_section's shallow merge behavior for other reserved sections.
